newsitem.title: USA: Alteon licenses pimagedine to IDEXX.
newsitem.headline: Alteon licenses pimagedine to IDEXX.

text.p: Alteon Inc will license to IDEXX Laboratories Inc its lead compound pimagedine to combat diabeties and aging in dogs, cats and horses, the companies said in a joint statement Wednesday.

Under the agreement, IDEXX will be responsible for the development, licensing and marketing of pimagedine and the A.G.E. diagnostics technology for animals, which Alteon also licensed to IDEXX. Alteon will receive milestone payments and royalties on the licensed products' sales.
